docker_compose_yml:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: blivoai-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=blivoai
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=BlvPg_eZdU18PPULDS4YsemB1CquWN
      - POSTGRES_DB=blivoai
    volumes:
      - blivoai-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - blivoai-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U blivoai"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '1.0'

  chatbot:
    build: .
    container_name: blivoai-chatbot
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://blivoai:BlvPg_eZdU18PPULDS4YsemB1CquWN@postgres:5432/blivoai?schema=public
      - NEXTAUTH_SECRET=${NEXTAUTH_SECRET:-change-this-secret-in-production}
      - NEXTAUTH_URL=${NEXTAUTH_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
      - GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}
      - GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      - PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=${PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID:-}
      - PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=${PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      - PAYPAL_BASE_URL=${PAYPAL_BASE_URL:-https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com}
      - RESEND_API_KEY=${RESEND_API_KEY:-}
      - TOGETHER_API_KEY=${TOGETHER_API_KEY:-}
      - GROQ_API_KEY=${GROQ_API_KEY:-}
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}
      - DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY:-}
      - OPENROUTER_API_KEY=${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-}
      - GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=${GITHUB_CLIENT_ID:-}
      - GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=${GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      - STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}
      - STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=${STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-}
      - STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=${STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:-}
      - DODO_API_KEY=${DODO_API_KEY:-}
      - DODO_WEBHOOK_KEY=${DODO_WEBHOOK_KEY:-}
    volumes:
      - ./google-service-account.json:/app/google-service-account.json:ro
      - blivoai-uploads:/app/data/uploads
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - blivoai-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "fetch('http://localhost:3000').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  caddy:
    image: caddy:2
    container_name: blivoai-caddy
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile
      - caddy-data:/data
      - caddy-config:/config
    depends_on:
      - chatbot
    networks:
      - blivoai-net

networks:
  blivoai-net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  blivoai-postgres-data:
  blivoai-uploads:
  caddy-data:
  caddy-config:

prisma_schema:
generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"
  binaryTargets = ["native", "linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x", "debian-openssl-3.0.x", "debian-openssl-1.1.x"]
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  email           String    @unique
  name            String?
  passwordHash    String?
  image           String?
  role            String    @default("USER") // USER, ADMIN
  planId          String?
  plan            Plan?     @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  messageCount    Int       @default(0)
  tokensUsed      Int       @default(0) // tokens used this month
  imagesGenerated Int       @default(0) // images generated this month
  paypalOrderId   String?  // PayPal order ID
  isActive        Boolean   @default(true)
  emailVerified   Boolean   @default(false) // Email verification status
  verificationCode String?  // 6-digit code for email verification
  verificationExpiry DateTime? // When the verification code expires
  verificationDeadline DateTime? // 5-minute deadline after signup; account deleted if not verified
  // Dodo Payments fields
  dodoCustomerId       String?  // Dodo customer ID
  dodoSubscriptionId   String?  // Dodo subscription ID
  dodoSubscriptionStatus String? @default("inactive") // inactive, active, on_hold, cancelled, expired, failed
  dodoCurrentPeriodEnd DateTime? // When the current subscription period ends
  dodoPaymentId        String?  // Latest Dodo payment ID
  conversations   Conversation[]
  apiKeys         ApiKey[]
  memories        Memory[]
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model Plan {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  description  String    @default("")
  price        Float     @default(0)
  annualPrice  Float?    // Annual price (null = no annual option)
  annualDiscountPercent Float? // Discount % for annual (e.g. 20 = 20% off monthly×12)
  currency     String    @default("USD")
  messageLimit Int       @default(100)
  tokenLimit   Int       @default(5000) // tokens per month
  tier         String    @default("free") // free, basic, pro - determines available features
  paypalPlanId  String?  // PayPal plan ID for subscription
  dodoProductId  String?  // Dodo Payments product ID for monthly subscription
  dodoProductIdAnnual  String?  // Dodo Payments product ID for annual subscription
  features     String    @default("[]") // JSON array of feature strings
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true)
  isDefault    Boolean   @default(false)
  users        User[]
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model AIModel {
  id           String        @id @default(cuid())
  name         String        @unique // Internal name like "gpt-4o"
  displayName  String        // User-facing name - admin can change this
  provider     String        @default("openai") // openai, anthropic, google, custom
  apiKey       String        @default("") // API key for this model
  baseUrl      String        @default("") // Custom base URL
  description  String        @default("")
  isFree       Boolean       @default(false) // Free or paid model
  isActive     Boolean       @default(true)
  sortOrder    Int           @default(0)
  systemPrompt String       @default("") // Admin-defined system prompt prepended to every conversation using this model
  conversations Conversation[]
  createdAt    DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime      @updatedAt
}

model Conversation {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title     String    @default("New Conversation")
  modelId   String?
  model     AIModel?  @relation(fields: [modelId], references: [id])
  isPinned  Boolean   @default(false) // Pinned conversations
  messages  Message[]
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model Message {
  id             String       @id @default(cuid())
  conversationId String
  conversation   Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role           String       // user, assistant, system
  content        String
  tokens         Int          @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime     @default(now())
}

model PlatformSetting {
  id    String @id @default(cuid())
  key   String @unique
  value String @default("")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model ApiKey {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  key       String   @unique
  name      String   @default("Default")
  // For BlivoAI API keys (programmatic access), provider is null.
  // For AI provider keys (user's own GitHub token, OpenAI, Together, etc.), provider is set.
  provider  String?  // github, openai, anthropic, together, groq, etc.
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  lastUsed  DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, provider])
}

model PasswordReset {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  email     String
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  used      Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Visitor {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  path      String
  referrer  String?
  country   String?
  sessionId String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([path])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  message   String
  type      String   @default("info") // info, success, warning, error, promotion
  audience  String   @default("all") // all, free, basic, pro, user (specific user)
  userId    String?  // For user-specific notifications (when audience = "user")
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  link      String?  // Optional URL the notification links to
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  expiresAt DateTime?

  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([audience])
}


// User memory: persistent facts about the user across all conversations
// The AI extracts these facts automatically and they're injected into the system prompt
// so the AI "remembers" the user across conversations.
model Memory {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  category  String   @default("fact") // fact, preference, project, person, goal, context
  content   String   // the memory text
  source    String   @default("auto") // auto (AI extracted), manual (user added)
  importance Int     @default(5) // 1-10, higher = more important
  lastAccessed DateTime? @default(now())
  accessCount Int    @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([userId, category])
  @@index([userId, isActive])
}


// Dynamic content sections - editable from admin panel
// Each section (hero, use_cases, why_blivoai, features, footer) has items
// Each item has: key (title/desc), value_en, value_ar, icon, order
// Admin writes English, AI auto-translates to Arabic
model ContentSection {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  section   String   // hero, use_cases, why_blivoai, features, footer, cta
  itemKey   String   // title, subtitle, description, item_1_title, item_1_desc, etc.
  valueEn   String   @default("") // English value (admin writes this)
  valueAr   String   @default("") // Arabic value (auto-translated, editable)
  icon      String?  // optional icon name (lucide icon)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([section, itemKey])
  @@index([section])
  @@index([section, isActive])
}

model UserNotificationRead {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  notificationId  String
  readAt          DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, notificationId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// Blog posts for content marketing and SEO
model BlogPost {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  title           String
  slug            String   @unique
  excerpt         String   @default("")
  content         String   @default("") // Markdown content (English)
  coverImage      String   @default("")
  tags            String   @default("") // comma-separated (English)
  author          String   @default("BlivoAI Team")
  // Bilingual support - Arabic versions
  titleAr         String   @default("")
  excerptAr       String   @default("")
  contentAr       String   @default("") // Markdown content (Arabic)
  tagsAr          String   @default("") // comma-separated (Arabic)
  isPublished     Boolean  @default(false)
  isFeatured      Boolean  @default(false)
  views           Int      @default(0) // Total views (legacy/aggregate)
  viewsEn         Int      @default(0) // English-version views
  viewsAr         Int      @default(0) // Arabic-version views
  metaTitle       String   @default("")
  metaDescription String   @default("")
  coverImageAlt   String   @default("") // Alt text for cover image - English (SEO + accessibility)
  coverImageAltAr String   @default("") // Alt text for cover image - Arabic (SEO + accessibility)
  coverImageTitle String   @default("") // Title (tooltip) for cover image - English
  coverImageTitleAr String @default("") // Title (tooltip) for cover image - Arabic
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([isPublished])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([slug])
}


/// Advertisements for blog posts
model Ad {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  imageUrl    String
  linkUrl     String
  altText     String?
  /// Placement: "all_blogs" = all blog posts, "blog_page" = /blog listing, "specific_post" = one post, "all_posts" = all individual posts
  placement   String   @default("all_blogs")
  /// If placement is "specific_post", this holds the blog post slug
  postSlug    String?
  /// Position in the article: "top", "middle", "bottom", "sidebar"
  position    String   @default("middle")
  /// Auto-delete after this date (optional)
  expiresAt   DateTime?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  impressions Int      @default(0)
  clicks      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  
  @@index([placement, isActive])
  @@index([postSlug])
}
